import { VideoDetail } from './core/core/uzVideo.js';
// ignore
async function searchVideo(args) {
  return JSON.stringify({ data: [] });
}

async function getClassList() {
  return JSON.stringify({ class: [{ type_id: 'hot', type_name: '热门' }] });
}

async function getVideoList(args) {
  const data = [];
  for (let i = 1; i <= 40; i++) {
    data.push({ vod_id: 'u-' + i, vod_name: '更新作品 ' + i, vod_pic: '', type_name: '动画' });
  }
  return JSON.stringify({ data });
}

async function getVideoDetail(args) {
  return JSON.stringify({
    data: {
      vod_name: '星海 动画',
      vod_play_from: '线路1',
      vod_play_url: '第1集$http://localhost:8123/test/fixtures/video.m3u8',
    },
  });
}

async function getVideoPlayUrl(args) {
  return JSON.stringify({ urls: [{ name: '高清', url: args.url }] });
}
